newsitems.title: Mining for that one single golden bit in '10 Million Pixels' is going to consume me
newsitems.contents: Another interesting upcoming incremental game here for you called 10 Million Pixels, and it's all about hunting for the golden pixel. Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2026/08/mining-for-that-one-single-golden-bit-in-10-million-pixels-is-going-to-consume-me/
